9:20 PM

Here are 5 must-see places in Jaipur, with Amber Fort the one to start with. Hawa Mahal, Jantar Mantar and City Palace are close together, so you can do them on foot in one go. The pins are approximate.

Amber Fort
Hilltop fort north of the city. Go early to beat the crowds.
2
Nahargarh Fort
Best sunset view over the Pink City.
3
City Palace
Royal palace and museum in the old city.
4
Jantar Mantar
18th-century observatory, right next to City Palace.
5
Hawa Mahal
The Palace of Winds. Best photographed in the morning.
